text: Main Courses: Advanced Chinese Language, Advanced Oral Chinese, Advanced Chinese Listening, Chinese Culture, Medium Chinese Writing, HSK Training (Preliminary/Medium/Advanced). Descriptions: HSK Band 4 is a precondition. Students will improve Chinese language proficiency through practice. Students could pass HSK Band 8 after learning. Average number of students: about 7. Study Duration: half a year or one year. Tuition: RMB 6500 for one semester; and RMB 13000 for one year.
